titulus: Sanctorum Ioachim et Annæ, parentum beatæ Mariæ Virginis
collecta: Dómine, Deus patrum nostrórum, qui beátis Ioachim et Annæ hanc grátiam contulísti ut ex eis incarnáti Fílii tui Mater nascerétur: utríusque précibus concéde; ut salútem tuo promíssam pópulo consequámur.

antiphonae_evangelicae.benedictus: Qui fácit voluntátem Patris mei, qui in cælis est, ipse meus frater, et soror, et mater est, dicit Dóminus.
antiphonae_evangelicae.benedictus_es: «El que cumple la voluntad de mi Padre, ése es mi hermano y mi hermana y mi madre», dice el Señor.
antiphonae_evangelicae.magnificat: Vos qui reliquístis ómnia, et secúti estis me, céntuplum accipiétis, et vitam ætérnam possidébitis.
antiphonae_evangelicae.magnificat_es: Vosotros, los que lo habéis dejado todo y me habéis seguido, recibiréis cien veces más, y heredaréis la vida eterna.

source_note: Magnificat/Benedictus antiphons were previously the wrong shared COMMON_HOLY_MEN_WOMEN placeholder text. Replaced with the genuine Common of Holy Men and Women pairing (see commons.json). NOTE: breviarium-core's own 'cantico_evangelico_antifona' field for this saint looked suspect on inspection (the Magnificat value was an unrelated Luke 11:1 verse about the Our Father, and the Benedictus value was just the opening line of the Benedictus canticle itself, Luke 1:68-69 — both look like an upstream data error in breviarium-core for this specific entry, not usable). Collect verified correct (names Joachim and Anne, not swapped with anyone else).
